items.t: 2027 GRIs: 5.9% again at UPS and FedEx, dates shift a little
items.body: UPS announced its Dec. 21, 2026 increase (5.9% average net) on Oct. 23, 2026; for 2026 it announced 5.9% on Oct. 31, 2025, effective Dec. 22, 2025. FedEx announced its 5.9% average on Sept. 18, 2026, effective Jan. 4, 2027, against an announcement on Sept. 12, 2025 and an effective date of Jan. 5, 2026, and the 2027 figure is its fourth straight 5.9% headline. Earlier averages were 4.9% in 2018 (UPS effective Dec. 24, 2017) and 6.9% in 2023 (UPS effective Dec. 27, 2022).

items.t: UPS surcharges rise faster than the 5.9% average, as in prior years
items.body: For rates effective Dec. 21, 2026, an analysis dated Nov. 6 says all 20 of the most common UPS surcharges rise more than 5.9%, averaging 9.1%. UPS Ground residential goes to $7.10 from $6.50, after $6.10 to $6.50 in the 2026 increase (effective Dec. 22, 2025) and $4.45 to $4.85 in 2022 (effective Dec. 26, 2021). FedEx's Jan. 4, 2027 changes lift Additional Handling to $31.75-$43.75 by zone from $29.50-$40.75.

items.t: 2026 peak charges are above 2025 levels at FedEx, UPS and USPS
items.body: FedEx announced its 2026 demand surcharges on July 22 (July 8 in 2025). For Nov. 23-Dec. 27 it lists Ground residential at $0.80 (2025: $0.65), Additional Handling at $11.85 (2025: $10.90) and Ground Economy at $4.05 (2025: $3.55). UPS lists Large Package at $117.50 in its peak window (2025: $107) and Over Maximum Limits at $590 (2025: $540), while USPS's retail Priority Mail and Ground Advantage Zone 1-4 0-3 lb add-on is $0.50 (2025: $0.40; 2024: $0.30) and runs on top of the temporary 8% increase.

items.t: Fuel tables: UPS has changed them repeatedly in 2026
items.body: UPS's Mar. 9, 2026 increase was its third of the year, and tables were also changed Aug. 10 and Nov. 2, with new tables set for Nov. 16 (announced Nov. 12) at 0.50 point higher per band. In 2025 UPS made table changes on Mar. 10, May 26 and Jun. 23, and in 2021 on Aug. 16 and Nov. 15. UPS and FedEx Ground each reached 20% in June 2025, above the 19.50% FedEx level of mid-2022; the UPS Nov. 2, 2026 flyer lists Ground at 30.00% for diesel of $6.25-$6.34, and FedEx's surcharge was reported at 30.5% on Nov. 12.

items.t: USPS: off-cycle changes in 2026 reach a fuel surcharge proposal
items.body: USPS's temporary 8% increase took effect Apr. 26, 2026 (announced Mar. 25), and Ground Advantage Commercial rose an average 11.8% on Jul. 12 (announced May 11). Earlier mid-year changes were Parcel Select +25% on Jul. 14, 2024 and Priority Mail +6.3%, Ground Advantage +7.1% on Jul. 13, 2025. On Nov. 12, 2026 USPS filed for a 5.9% average increase and an 11% fuel surcharge replacing the 8% charge, effective Jan. 17 pending PRC review; in Jan. 2021 USPS had noted it applied no fuel surcharge.

items.t: New in 2026: per-pound country fees, cubic triggers, lower DIM divisor
items.body: FedEx added a Vietnam-to-U.S. import surcharge of $0.36 per lb for priority-class and $0.27 for economy-class services effective Nov. 2, 2026, and UPS and FedEx also carry per-pound fees on Middle East lanes since March; in 2025 the international peak fees of $0.10 to $0.52 per lb ran in dated windows. FedEx (Jan. 12) and UPS (Jan. 26) moved Additional Handling to a cubic-size trigger of over 10,368 cu in, a different kind of test from the UPS Large Package and over-70 lb Additional Handling surcharges introduced in July 2018. USPS cut its DIM divisor from 166 to 139 on Jul. 12, 2026, after the 194-to-166 cut in June 2019; UPS moved its divisor for packages of 1 cu ft or less to 139 in 2018.
